newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes float higher in technical market.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes float higher in technical market.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes tracked a slightly higher course Friday afternoon, following the lead of NYMEX futures prices, while domestic grades retained gains.

June West Texas Intermediate/Cushing was around 5-10 cents higher at $20.35-45 a barrel. June/July spreads continued to attract the most attention, talked around 4-6 cents in favor of the prompt month.
June WTI/Cushing Postings Plus moved to wider numbers on the back of the June/July turnaround, selling most recently at $2.05, 10 cents higher than late Thursday levels.
"People are interested in getting P (P-Plus) done today," said a cash dealer.
Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James was sold steady from the morning at 7 cents over the benchmark, while Heavy Louisiana Sweet/Empire barely moved from talk at 40-25 cents under WTI.
Sour differentials improved, as West Texas Sour/Midland sold at a $1.47 discount to WTI/Cushing, some 10 cents stronger than late talk yesterday and in-line with firmer numbers recorded on Wednesday.
Eugene Island was valued around WTI/Cushing -$1.40, 5 cents stronger than last trades on Thursday.
Firmer prices for grades came on the lack of prompt foreign offerings and increased refiner demand.
